technologies.description: Analyzing the recovered bioimplants from the lone scientist's body will be a great boon to our longevity research.

technologies.name: Scourge Deployment
technologies.description: The Scarlet Scourge is an advanced synthetic toxin that could either be used as a terraforming agent, as originally intended, or as a planet-enveloping chemical weapon capable of destroying all life. Its use is up to us.

technologies.name: Katzen Atomic Munitions
technologies.description: The extremely militaristic and nuclear-loving Katzens have managed to destroy the surfaces of both Katzenland and Flusion with remarkable ease and efficiency. They seemed to employ a vast array of different explosives in order to deal as much damage as possible, ranging from radioactive fission warheads, to antimatter bombs, and biochemical weaponry. By adopting their methods, our ships could be made to completely devastate enemy worlds with ease.

technologies.name: Unconventional Macroengineering Methods
technologies.description: By analyzing the data from the odd Squareworld, we can learn a great deal about eccentric construction techniques and outside-the-box engineering.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Enhancements
technologies.description: The Compound is a threat to all life in the galaxy, and possibly even beyond. Our tests have shown that negative mass is the only thing we know of that can harm them. From this lead, we have begun to develop energy weapons that employ negative mass so that we can finally fight back.

By infusing a ship with the substance at the moment of a jump, we can massively reduce the vessel's mass, and consequently, the amount of energy required to translate it across space. This allows us to travel farther and more routinely on the same basic Jump Drive design.

technologies.name: Sentient Metal Railgun

technologies.name: Sentient Metal Artillery
technologies.description: The Sentient Metal Artillery amalgamates and then fires a large spike of Sentient Metal programmed to absorb any form of matter it comes into contact with. Fighters and small ships are immediately assimilated; larger ships sustain heavy damage as sentient metal rips chunks out of their hull.

technologies.name: Sentient Metal Absorber
technologies.description: The Sentient Metal Absorber launches enormous Sentient Metal spikes, often large enough to fully assimilate smaller ships in a single shot.

technologies.name: Sentient Metal Devourer
technologies.description: The Sentient Metal Devourer doesn't directly utilize sentient metal to damage its targets. Rather, it uses the material's connection to the Everchanging, along with the Enigmatic Pattern, to have the Everchanging open a power transfer micro wormhole. It directs the resultant colossal outpouring of energy towards enemy vessels.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Point Defense
technologies.description: The Negative Mass Point Defense fires an expanding wave of negative mass towards incoming projectiles, throwing them off-course.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Laser
technologies.description: The Negative Mass Laser employs a focused negative mass conduit to decohere any form of matter, baryonic or otherwise.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Pseudoplasma Launcher
technologies.description: The Negative Mass Pseudoplasma Launcher fires coherent spheres of negative mass that explosively disrupt any form of matter they strike.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Disruptor
technologies.description: The Negative Mass Disruptor fires waves of tremendously destructive negative mass which decohere large swathes of matter. Unfortunately, these waves dissipate after a short distance.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Torpedoes
technologies.description: Negative Mass Torpedoes use the repulsive force of negative mass to amplify the destructive power of our packed neutron warheads.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Lance

technologies.name: Negative Mass Emitter
technologies.description: The Negative Mass Emitter fires a scatter-shot of randomly polarized and spun negative mass rays, to which dedicated defenses are nothing but more hull.

technologies.name: Negative Mass Beam
technologies.description: The Negative Mass Beam is a titanic focused ray that decoheres vast swathes of matter in a single hit.

technologies.name: Photonic Matter Utilization
technologies.description: The ability to precisely manipulate electromagnetic wave interference patterns has allowed us to construct stable standing waves capable of interaction with the physical world in ways resembling mundane matter. This "photonic" matter shows great promise in micro-scale manipulation tasks, and will be invaluable in the field of shield harmonics.

technologies.name: Negative Pressure Application
technologies.description: Negative pressure is a phenomenon that has been observed before at the quantum level, in the form of the Casimir effect. There, it manifests in form of vacuum fluctuations, but is uncontrollable. Applied abstract physics has lead to the discovery of better-applicable and more efficient ways to generate and control negative pressure.

technologies.name: E.H.O.F. Lambda
technologies.description: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes. The photonic matter and negative pressure enhance the entire process, increasing the Event Horizon Offset Facility's precision and expanding its range of destinations.

technologies.name: Horizon Drive
technologies.description: This device, mounted on the spine of an Arkship, utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, squeezed electromagnetic fields, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes.

technologies.name: Quoudroplean Formalism
technologies.description: As abstract physics is very different to other branches of physics, it necessitates customized mathematical formalism to efficiently express it. This "Quoudroplean Formalism" makes use of truly alien mathematical frameworks and theorems that don't fit into the classical universe of mathematics and were thought to be entirely inapplicable and inadequate for reality.

technologies.name: Unorthodox Reality Examination Techniques
technologies.description: The unconventional approaches and principles of abstract physics require the construction of new research facilities to develop alternative investigation methods for the comprehension of reality.

technologies.name: Negative Energy Studies
technologies.description: Negative energy has been a purely hypothetical, controversial, and extremely abstract topic for a long time... at least until the discovery of the mind-bending negative mass. Abstract physics will allow us to further study this seemingly impossible, yet undeniably real, phenomenon.

details.text: Has federation perk is Scientific Inspiration

technologies.name: Sterile Hyper-Neutrino Detection
technologies.description: A unique form of exotic dark matter originating from hyperspace, sterile hyper-neutrinos radiate from the opening of micro wormholes. They possess unique frequencies related to the location that the micro wormholes lead to. By analyzing these frequencies, we can predict the target of an micro wormhole with much higher precision, increasing the accuracy of our Event Horizon Offset Facility.

technologies.name: Hardlight Construct Utilization
technologies.description: Dominion over the electromagnetic field will grant us the ability to create pure hardlight constructs, advanced and powerful extensions of photonic matter. These constructs will be able to directly manipulate elementary particles and thus provide even further control of matter and energy.

technologies.name: Prototype Negative Mass Utilities
technologies.description: The first generation of devices, processes and methods that utilize negative mass. They are still experimental prototypes and don't utilize the full potential of negative mass, but are powerful nonetheless.

technologies.name: E.H.O.F. Omega
technologies.description: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, hardlight constructs, sterile sub-neutrino detectors, and negative mass to manipulate and inflate micro wormholes. The utilization of negative mass induces total stabilization of wormholes, which allows us to keep the inflated micro wormholes open for as long as we see fit. The sterile sub-neutrino detectors further expand the range of destinations our micro wormholes can reach.

technologies.name: Non-paradoxical Information Supercausality
technologies.description: The transportation of information, matter and energy in non-abstract physics is strictly bound to the speed of causality, which in itself is limited and relatively small compared to the size of the universe. Faster-than-causality transmission can only be achieved in circumstances where no information is transmitted or spacetime is bent. However, in abstract physics, the boundaries between fixed rules and unfixed potentialities are themselves fluid and shifting. There are certain ways to work around these rules, change them, or even simply ignore them. As absurd as it may appear.

technologies.name: Supercausal Research Initiatives
technologies.description: The supercausal phenomena of abstract physics require their own kind of advanced, complex, and powerful research facilities.

technologies.name: Advanced Negative Mass Utilities

technologies.name: Micro Wormhole Destination Precognition
technologies.description: Unimaginably sensitive tachyon sensors, based on and aided by the astonishing capabilities of the sentient metal hive-intellect, determine the target of a micro wormhole before it even emerges in real space. This prediction of wormhole targets increases the precision of Event Horizon Offset Facility travel to a seemingly impossible degree. With this technology, our Event Horizon Offset Facility will be able to form a micro wormhole connecting it to any destination in the galaxy.

technologies.name: Electroweak Quasi-Field Materialization
technologies.description: Extremely high energy states lead to the unification of the electromagnetic and weak forces into their initial force, the electroweak force. The secrets of the Everchanging revealed how to manifest physical "Electroweak Quasi-Fields", which open up possibilities for tremendously precise field and spacetime manipulation, even down to the level of quantum foam itself.

technologies.name: E.H.O.F. Ultima
technologies.description: Utilizing the mysteries of the Everchanging, the E.H.O.F. Ultima is the perfect form of the Event Horizon Offset Facility, capable of traveling to any location of our choosing without limitations and risks. Limitless possibilities await.

technologies.description: Studying the Blokkat Scrap recovered from destroyed Blokkat vessels is surely going to be a great boon to our Blokkat research.

technologies.name: Long-Term Blokkat Scrap Analysis
technologies.description: A slower and more careful approach to our analysis of Blokkat Scrap will yield more permanent results.

technologies.name: Long-Term Blokkat Scrap Weaponization
technologies.description: A slower and more careful approach to our utilization of Blokkat Scrap in our own vessels will yield more permanent results. The scrap can most notably be used to figure out ways to assault Blokkat vessels and structures from multiple dimensions at once.

technologies.name: Planck-Dismantlement Beam
technologies.description: The Planck-Dismantlement Beam is a Blokkat device based on their stripmining apparatuses. Not only do these devices systematically dismantle the very fabric of enemy ships down to the subplanck level, reducing them to a slurry of hypercondensed quantum foam, they also collect said foam and store it aboard Blokkat vessels, where it can later be reprocessed into usable materials.

technologies.name: Tetradimensional Singularity Cannon
technologies.description: These advanced launchers catapult a seeking four-dimensional singularity towards enemy ships. While they appear detached from Blokkat ships, these singularities are actually more akin to "lassos", as they are connected to Blokkat vessels through a higher dimension and are later "reeled back" by said vessels through this higher dimension after plowing through enemy ships. This enables the Blokkats to collect whatever the singularities destroyed and process it for later usage.

technologies.name: Blokk-Swarmer Units
technologies.description: These spaceborne units heavily resemble actual Blokkats themselves and are geared for spaceship combat. They are most often remotely controlled by Blokkats within the mothership and are even sometimes Blokkats.

technologies.name: Planckalloy Plating
technologies.description: These extremely tough armor platings are made up of tightly-packed Planck length-sized particles. They form complex subatomic neural structures allowing the material to autonomously react to changes and adapt accordingly near-instantaneously.

technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Shiftbarrier
technologies.description: Much like the Blokkat-Vester's humongous shield, these smaller protective barriers rotate within a higher dimension, meaning only an infinitely small chunk of the full shield is ever exposed to enemy fire at once. If it is damaged, the damaged area is instantly shifted back into hyperdimensional space to be regenerated.

technologies.name: Blokk-Guardian Point-Defence System
technologies.description: These hyperefficient point-defence systems shatter the very fabric of reality around enemy projectiles, obliterating them before they even get close to Blokkat vessels.

technologies.name: Absolute Scorch Blaster
technologies.description: The Absolute Scorch Blaster fires a glob of plasma heated to the Planck Temperature, which is practically the highest possible temperature under known models of physics. The plasma is kept to these extreme temperatures by a constant influx of energy through a higher dimension and matter which comes in contact with the plasma is "absorbed" into said dimension, converted into energy in a way similar to how Blokkats harvest star systems and then fueled back into the plasma to further sustain the projectile's heat.

technologies.name: Pentafocused Emitter
technologies.description: The Pentafocused emitter is a titanic piercing weapon of Blokkat design, which is capable of "leaping" through a higher dimension in order to bypass the shielding and armor of energy vessels.

technologies.name: Evictor Ray
technologies.description: The Evictor Ray is the largest Blokkat weapon encountered so far. This beam of untold power tears reality asunder and forcefully compresses its target into a 0-dimensional object by focusing the energies of several higher dimensions onto a localized area of the spacetime continuum, destroying it instantly.

technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Capacitor
technologies.description: Reactor boosters drawing additional energy from a higher-dimensional source. They also serve to improve the efficiency of the vessel as a whole.

technologies.name: Manifold Thrusters
technologies.description: In addition to their esoteric FTL thrusters, Blokkat vessels employ these thrusters which push against the very fabric of our universe in order to boost the speed of their crafts even further.

technologies.name: Subplanck Synchronizers
technologies.description: Swarms of miniscule robots that serve as relays for the neural networks contained within Blokkat armors, increasing their efficiency and enabling them to repair faster. Blokkat models also transmit data to and from the Blokkwork for increased synchronization.

technologies.name: Blokkat Phaseshift Transportation
technologies.description: There is no effective difference between a Blokkat thruster and a Blokkat FTL drive. They both employ a sort of device anchored through a higher dimension which quite literally "drags" the space surrounding the ship and moves it around with instantaneous acceleration.

technologies.name: Blokkat Reactor
technologies.description: Blokkat ships are powered by these mysterious constructs that draw untold amounts of energy transferred from a higher dimension.

technologies.name: Blokkat Shipbound Computers
technologies.description: The application of Blokkat technologies to the artificial intelligence of our vessels will enable us to create truly terrifying vessels of war.

technologies.name: Hyperbrane Sensors
technologies.description: These Blokkat-designed sensors look for the oscillations that 3-dimensional matter creates within the higher-dimensional manifold of the universe.

technologies.name: Early Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Schematics
technologies.description: The Hyperdimensional Stabilizer shall be one of the largest megastructures ever conceived, built for the sole purpose of bringing down the Blokkat-Vester's shield. Designing an appropriate construction site is a crucial step in the assembly of this colossal construct.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Megastructure: Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Construction Site

technologies.name: Pentadimensional Power Sources
technologies.description: A special black hole employing methods very much like that of the Blokkats could be used to power the mighty Hyperdimensional Destabilizer and effectively enable it to strike at the Blokkats' seemingly unbreakable shield.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Megastructure: Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Pentadimensional Converter

technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Branebreaking
technologies.description: By "skewing" the higher dimensions employed by the Blokkat Hyperdimensional Bulwark, we can forcefully bring it down one dimension, thus bringing it within the reach of our Pentadimensional Singularity.

technologies.name: Yottascale Energy Manipulation
technologies.description: Manipulating the sheer flow of energy required to bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark will require an untold number of higher-dimensional structures coupled with femtosecond-precision when it comes to executing the full sequence.

technologies.name: Applied Hypertemporal Chronodisruption
technologies.description: The ability to strike at a target from both the past, the future and higher dimensions will ensure we can bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark down with much greater ease than before. Additionally, the wider application of this technology to our weapons systems will noticeably increase their potential damage output.

technologies.name: Blokkwork Severing Protocols
technologies.description: By severing individual Blokkats' connection to the Blokkwork and neutralizing them, we might be able to ultimately contain them provided we possess the necessary infrastructure to deny their escape. This will require the construction of a specialized holding cell surrounding the Blokkat within hyperdimensional space.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Feature: Blokkat Capture Unlocks Megastructure: Blokkat Containment Nexus

technologies.name: Blokkat Consciousness Alteration
technologies.description: By delicately altering the mind of a Blokkat using egregiously delicate and expensive methods, we might just be able to "switch" their allegiance from their original civilization to ours.

technologies.name: Blokkat-Paluush Historiography Analysis
technologies.description: The analysis of the Blokkats' complex path intertwined with that of the Paluush will help us understand their mindset and technological evolution better.

technologies.name: Blokkat Temporal Displacement
technologies.description: The understanding and subsequent application of Blokkat femtosecond timetravel methods to effectively have a single item simultaneously undertake several operations in both the past and future is likely to be a great boon to both our own industry and Blokkat-related research.

technologies.name: Temporal Restoration
technologies.description: A colossal megastructure capable into the future to retrieve a star from another era of the universe might be what we need in order to undo the damage caused by the perfidious Blokkats.

technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Linguistics
technologies.description: Blokkat language revolves on an incredibly complex set of energy waves entangled within higher dimensions, transmitted across intergalactic distances through the Blokkwork. Managing to truly understand this language would surely let us establish closer relations with these beings.

unlocks.name: Lets us directly communicate in Blokkatese. Blokkat Knowledge: +1

technologies.name: Blokkilian Equations - Energy Primacy
technologies.description: The Blokkats have long since converted their technologies to be based on the most fundamental aspect of the universe: energy. They utilize the Blokkwork to transfer vast quantities of energy across great distances and subsequently shape this energy into whatever they may require. Understanding how to base an entire civilization on the universe's most basic resource is paramount to solving the Blokkilian Equations.

technologies.name: Blokkilian Equations - Intergalactic Logistics
technologies.description: How to properly coordinate harvesting operations spread over a significant portion of the observable universe involving the mass-energy of several galaxies being shipped across intergalactic distances? When one is running an operation as large as that of the Blokkats, inefficiency is simply unacceptable and logistics must thus be refined to perfection.

technologies.name: Blokkilian Equations - Planckscale Particle Generation
technologies.description: It is a known fact that the Blokkats no longer rely on baryonic matter to function, instead utilizing raw energy to create new types of elementary particles better fit for their operations. These particles can thus be extremely small and allow for their devices to be much, much denser than ones built using conventional particles. If we are to understand how they achieved such a feat, we must study how the Blokkats utilize the Blokkwork to spontaneously generate particles capable of projecting their will down to the Planck scale.

technologies.name: Blokkwork Power Nodes - Direct Blokkwork Connection
technologies.description: With our newfound understanding of Blokkat technology granted by the Blokkilian Equations, we are now ready to truly prepare our ascension by establishing the necessary infrastructure to connect ourselves to the Blokkwork. Although these power nodes will not let us access the full extent of the Blokkwork for now (as it is not yet completely established over our galaxy), they will nonetheless let us greatly streamline our planetary operations by generating our own Blokkwork across our empire.

technologies.name: Blokkwork Pylon - Hyperbranic Frame
technologies.description: The Pylon's frame is to be an intricate 6-dimensional construct embedded into the fabric of reality itself. Such a degree of sophistication is required if we are to bring the Blokkwork's full power into our galaxy.

technologies.name: Blokkwork Pylon - Dimensional Power Core
technologies.description: The Pylon's Power Core shall provide a direct link to the Blokkwork itself and enable the flow of near endless energy from the Blokkwork to our Blokkwork Power Node network.

technologies.name: Semithaumaturgic Crystalline Weaponry
technologies.description: Faust's inhabitants have devised rifles and weapons infused with powerful crystals which far surpass conventional weaponry. While it might have appeared to be magic to them, which drastically limited just how much they could propagate the technology, a thorough study into the nature of these crystals might just enable us to standardize their usage within our armed forces. This would however entail a significant Rare Crystal upkeep cost.

technologies.name: Industrial Psicatalyzed Fusion
technologies.description: Replicating the esoteric workings of Helios' infernal core within a controlled environment and on an industrial scale enables tremendous energy production and the facilitated production of heavy elements.

technologies.name: Thaumaturgic Enthrallment
technologies.description: Studying how the Sirens unleash their enthralling spell could have great application for our government and society.

technologies.name: Early Sirens Countermeasures
technologies.description: While the deeper nature of the Sirens' mysterious song still eludes us, preliminary studies suggest that firing focused discharges of energy at specific frequencies into quasi-space can mitigate some of the Strife Field's effects, at the cost of drastically increasing the upkeep of the ships these mechanisms are mounted on.

technologies.name: Disenchanter Tuning
technologies.description: More careful attuning of the Disenchanter mechanisms allow for more efficient countering of the Strife Field's nefarious effects.

technologies.name: Subpsionic Symphonies
technologies.description: Breakthroughs in our understand of the Strife Field's enable us to directly emit counter-melodies to the Sirens' songs within the Immaterium itself, which can ward off even the nefarious Inner Field's mind-controlling effects.

unlocks.name: Allows capture of Starbases and Planets in the Inner Field.

technologies.name: Euphonic Strife Dissipation
technologies.description: Our understanding of the Sirens' song has now progressed to the point where we can comfortably nullify their mind-controlling field at any scale, albeit at a non-negligible energy cost.

technologies.name: Harass Decoys
technologies.description: Instead of being more conventional assault strike crafts, these high-health fighters exist only to overwhelm, harass and disorient enemy strike craft and PD systems, thus helping our other weapons inflict more damage.

technologies.name: Crystalline Autocannon
technologies.description: These autocannons spray a flurry of razor-sharp thaumaturgic crystals which, while they struggle to puncture thick armor and are generally stopped clean by shields, can absolutely devastate the more fragile hull of energy starships if it happens to be exposed.

technologies.name: Crystalline Artillery
technologies.description: These artilleries fire large crystalline projectiles imbued with excess psionic energy rendering them somewhat unstable and thus very effective against general enemy defenses.

technologies.name: Thaumaturgic Charge
technologies.description: This unorthodox missile design relies on a ball of charged thaumaturgic crystals lobbed through the void of space. Guided by a partial sentience wishing only to see the destruction of its opponents, it can slip through shields and armor alike in order to cause maximum carnage upon its beloathed foes.

technologies.name: Crystalline Impactor
technologies.description: The Crystalline Impactor relies on thaumaturgic crystals imbued with partial sentience in order to produce devastating seeking projectiles at extremely high velocities meant to damage and penetrate armor.

technologies.name: Grand Void Beam
technologies.description: This gargantuan beam has the interest effect of psionically-maximizing the entropy of its target, rendering it very efficient against shielding systems.

technologies.name: Supercharged Thaumaturgic Weaponry
technologies.description: The esoteric nature of thaumaturgic weaponry means there is essentially no upper limit on their potential. As long as more energy can be pumped in alongside more crystals to carry that energy, they can continue getting more and more powerful.
